title: Roveia floating nav pill
description: A white, fully rounded nav pill with a soft 30px shadow floating 24px from the top: wordmark left, a row of links (some with chevrons) that dim to 64% on hover, and a dark pill CTA that turns blue. On phones a slim two-line burger opens a white panel.
notes: fixed by default; pass position="static" to keep it in the flow
the phone menu is a <details> element, so it works without JavaScript
name: roveia-header

props.name: brandMark
props.description: tiny mark above the wordmark's first letter

props.name: links
props.description: the links in the middle of the pill (desktop) and in the drop-down (phones)

props.name: cta
props.description: the dark pill on the right

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the phone menu button

props.name: position
props.description: fixed (default) floats over the page; static stays in the flow (for previews)
